in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sree is a name of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is the consort of Vishnu and is often depicted with gold coins and lotus flowers.
